title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EMPLOYMENT OF A MASTER BUILDER BY THE BUREAU OF ARCHITECTURE AND CONSTRUCTION OF PUBLIC BUILDINGS.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EMPLOYMENT OF A MASTER BUILDER BY THE BUREAU OF ARCHITECTURE AND CONSTRUCTION OF PUBLIC BUILDINGS.

text.en:
The Chief of the Bureau of Architecture and Construction of Public Building is hereby authorized
to employ as a subordinate in his office a master builder at an annual salary to be fixed by the Chief of the
Bureau, not exceeding two thousand two hundred and fifty dollars, in money of the United States.
The master builder shall perform such duties as may be assigned to him by the Chief of the

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 24, 1902.
